mechanism.claim: When simultaneous BTC spot and perpetual aggressive quote-flow imbalances have opposite signs and their absolute divergence is causally extreme, cash and leverage are demanding opposite directions. During elevated BTC variation, follow the spot aggressive-flow direction for eight hours as cash inventory resolves the disagreement.
mechanism.side: strict sign of completed spot normalized taker imbalance
mechanism.why_distinct: Spot-flow leadership uses a two-hour spot imbalance magnitude and same-direction price confirmation at fixed eight-hour boundaries. Leverage-to-cash handoff uses ordered four-hour dominance transfer. Cash participation uses unsigned turnover shares. HVFDR uses one irregular five-minute opposite-sign flow disagreement tail, no price-return direction, flow leadership ratio, volume level, basis, funding, OI, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: causal trailing perpetual 24-hour realized variation must occupy its upper 35 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: irregular cross-venue aggressive-flow disagreement onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.decision_grid: every exact UTC five-minute boundary D
features.market_bars: five exact coherent native one-minute BTCUSDT perpetual and spot rows [D-5m,D)
features.normalized_imbalance: (2*sum(taker_buy_quote)-sum(quote_asset_volume))/sum(quote_asset_volume) separately by venue; denominator strict positive
features.flow_disagreement: spot and perpetual imbalances have opposite strict signs
features.absolute_divergence: absolute value of spot imbalance minus perpetual imbalance
features.divergence_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 8640 jointly valid decisions, minimum 6048, current excluded; rank>=0.995
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact perpetual one-minute log(close/open) returns over [D-24h,D))
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 8640 jointly valid decisions, minimum 6048, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.onset: full directional disagreement true now and false at immediately prior exact source-valid decision; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.decision: D after both completed bars and causal ranks are available
clock.reservation: global chronological half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no venue, bar, flow normalization, disagreement, rank history, rank threshold, variation, onset, side, clock, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
